visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with long, wavy dark hair and a sparse mustache wears a grey hoodie in a brightly lit convenience store. He looks around with a neutral, contemplative expression as the camera captures him in a selfie-style close-up. (2) A hand reaches toward a refrigerated shelf filled with produce. It picks up a plastic bag containing green leafy vegetables (bok choy) from a selection of various packaged greens. (3) The man holds the bag of vegetables and a packaged red tomato close to his face, looking into the camera while standing in the store aisle. (4) The scene shifts to a modern kitchen with grey cabinetry. The man, wearing a hoodie with a SpongeBob SquarePants graphic, places the tomato and the bag of vegetables onto a grey countertop. (5) A series of close-up shots highlight the labels on the produce, showing a bright red tomato and vibrant green bok choy in their clear plastic packaging. (6) The man stands behind the counter, looking down at the ingredients and then back at the camera, appearing calm and focused on his task.
